an7.57:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā vesāliyaṃ viharati mahāvane kūṭāgārasālāyaṃ.
an7.57:1.3: atha kho sīho senāpati yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho sīho senāpati bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
an7.57:1.4: sakkā nu kho bhante sandiṭṭhikaṃ dānaphalaṃ paññāpetunti.
an7.57:2.1: tenahi sīha, taṃyeva tattha paṭipucchissāmi. yathā te khameyya tathā naṃ byākareyyāsi. (1)
an7.57:2.4: eko puriso assaddho maccharī kadariyo paribhāsako, eko puriso saddho dānapati anuppadānarato.
an7.57:2.5: taṃ kiṃ maññasi sīha kaṃ nu kho arahanto paṭhamaṃ anukampantā anukampeyyuṃ.
an7.57:2.6: yo vā so puriso assaddho maccharī kadariyo paribhāsako, yo vā puriso saddho dānapati anuppadānaratoti?
an7.57:3.1: yo so bhante, puriso assaddho maccharī kadariyo paribhāsako, kintaṃ arahanto paṭhamaṃ anukampantā anukampessantī.
an7.57:3.2: yo ca kho so bhante, puriso saddho dānapati anuppadānarato, taṃyeva arahanto paṭhamaṃ anukampantā anukampeyyuṃ. (2)
an7.57:4.1: taṃ kiṃ maññasi sīha, kaṃ nu kho arahanto paṭhamaṃ upasaṅkamantā upasaṅkameyyuṃ:
an7.57:4.2: yo vā so puriso assaddho macchirī kadariyo paribhāsako, yo vā so puriso saddho dānapati anuppadānaratoti?
an7.57:4.3: yo so bhante, puriso assaddho maccharī kadariyo paribhāsako, kiṃ taṃ arahanto paṭhamaṃ upasaṅkamantā upasaṅkamissanti
an7.57:4.4: yo ca kho so bhante, puriso saddho dānapati anuppadānarato, taṃyeva arahanto paṭhamaṃ upasaṅkamantā upasaṅkameyyuṃ. (3)
an7.57:5.1: taṃ kiṃ maññasi sīha, kassa nu kho arahanto paṭhamaṃ patigaṇhantā patigaṇheyyuṃ:
an7.57:5.2: yo vā so puriso assaddho maccharī kadariyo paribhāsako, yo vā so puriso saddho dānapati anuppadānaratoti?
an7.57:5.3: yo so bhante, puriso assaddho maccharī kadariyo paribhāsako, kiṃ tassa arahanto paṭhamaṃ patigaṇhantā patigaṇhissanti.
an7.57:5.4: yo ca kho so bhante, puriso saddho dānapati anuppadānarato, tasseva arahanto paṭhamaṃ patigaṇhantā patigaṇheyyuṃ: (4)
an7.57:6.1: taṃ kiṃ maññasi sīha, kassa nu kho arahanto paṭhamaṃ dhammaṃ desentā deseyyuṃ,
an7.57:6.2: yo vā so puriso assaddho maccharī kadariyo paribhāsako, yo vā so puriso saddho dānapati anuppadānaratoti?
an7.57:6.3: yo so bhante, puriso assaddho maccharī kadariyo paribhāsako, kiṃ tassa arahanto paṭhamaṃ dhammaṃ desentā desissanti,
an7.57:6.4: yo ca kho so bhante, puriso saddho dānapati anuppadānarato, tasseva arahanto paṭhamaṃ dhammaṃ desentā deseyyuṃ. (5)
an7.57:7.1: taṃ kiṃ maññasi sīha, kassa nu kho kalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggaccheyya
an7.57:7.2: yo vā so puriso assaddho maccharī kadariyo paribhāsako, yo vā so puriso saddho dānapati anuppadānaratoti?
an7.57:7.3: yo so bhante, puriso assaddho maccharī kadariyo paribhāsako kiṃ tassa kalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggacchissati,
an7.57:7.4: yo ca kho so bhante, puriso saddho dānapati anuppadānarato, tasseva kalyāṇo kitti saddo abbhuggaccheyya. (6)
an7.57:8.1: taṃ kiṃ maññasi sīha, ko nu kho yaññadeva parisaṃ upasaṅkameyya yadi khattiyaparisaṃ yadi brāhmaṇaparisaṃ yadi gahapatiparisaṃ yadi samaṇaparisaṃ visārado upasaṅkameyya amaṅkubhūto,
an7.57:8.2: yo vā so puriso assaddho maccharī kadariyo paribhāsako, yo vā so puriso saddho dānapati anuppadānaratoti?
an7.57:8.3: yo so bhante, puriso assaddho maccharī kadariyo paribhāsako, kiṃ so yaññadeva parisaṃ upasaṅkamissati, yadi khattiyaparisaṃ yadi brāhmaṇaparisaṃ yadi gahapatiparisaṃ yadi samaṇaparisaṃ, visārado upasaṅkamati amaṅkubhūto,
an7.57:8.4: yo ca kho so bhante, puriso saddho dānapati anuppadānarato, so yaññadeva parisaṃ upasaṅkameyya yadi khattiyaparisaṃ yadi brāhmaṇaparisaṃ yadi gahapatiparisaṃ yadi samaṇaparisaṃ visārado upasaṅkamati amaṅkubhūto. (7)
an7.57:9.1: taṃ kiṃ maññasi sīha, ko nu kho kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjissati,
an7.57:9.2: yo ca kho so puriso assaddho maccharī kadariyo paribhāsako, yo vā so puriso saddho dānapati anuppadānaratoti?
an7.57:9.3: yo so bhante puriso assaddho maccharī kadariyo paribhāsako, kiṃ so kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjissati,
an7.57:9.4: yo ca kho so bhante, puriso dānapati anuppadānarato, so kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjeyya.
an7.57:10.1: yānimāni bhante, bhagavatā cha sandiṭṭhikāni dānaphalāni akkhātāni, nāhaṃ ettha bhagavato saddhāya gacchāmi.
an7.57:10.3: ahaṃ bhante, dāyako dānapati. maṃ arahanto paṭhamaṃ anukampantā anukampanti.
an7.57:10.4: ahaṃ bhante, dāyako dānapati. maṃ arahanto paṭhamaṃ upasaṅkamantā upasaṅkamanti
an7.57:10.5: ahaṃ bhante, dāyako dānapati. mayhaṃ arahanto paṭhamaṃ patigaṇhantā patigaṇhanti.
an7.57:10.6: ahaṃ bhante, dāyako dānapati. mayhaṃ arahanto paṭhamaṃ dhammaṃ desentā desenti.
an7.57:10.7: ahaṃ bhante, dāyako dānapati. mayhaṃ kalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggato:
an7.57:10.9: ahaṃ bhante, dāyako dānapati. yaññadeva parisaṃ upasaṅkamāmi yadi khattiyaparisaṃ, yadi brāhmaṇaparisaṃ, yadi gahapatiparisaṃ yadi samaṇaparisaṃ, visārado upasaṅkamāmi amaṅkubhūto.
an7.57:10.10: yānimāni bhante, bhagavatā cha sandiṭṭhikāni dānaphalāni, akkhātāni, nāhaṃ ettha bhagavato saddhāya gacchāmi.
an7.57:10.12: yaṃ ca kho maṃ bhante, bhagavā evamāha:
an7.57:10.13: ‘dāyako sīha, dānapati kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjatī’ti.
an7.57:10.14: etāhaṃ na jānāmi. ettha ca panāhaṃ bhagavato saddhāya gacchāmi.
an7.57:10.16: dāyako sīha, dānapati kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjatīti.
